one_line: Frontend deployment and serverless platform whose REST API manages deployments, domains, env vars and projects.
auth_notes: Vercel Access Tokens sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' created in account settings; OAuth2 for third-party app integrations with scopes
self_serve_notes: Free (hobby) tier; access tokens self-serve from account settings, team resources accessed via teamId param
